name: NovelAI
tagline: NovelAI is a subscription platform for AI-assisted creative writing and image generation, focused on anime-style art and interactive narrative fiction. Its language model is fine-tuned on a curated corpus of literary fiction to produce prose that's more stylistically varied than general-purpose LLMs, and its image generator specialises in consistent character art for visual novels. Writers and artists in the anime and light-novel community use it as an all-in-one creative sandbox.
